as_told.title: Von Neumann starts lecturing on self-replicating machines after Roswell

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, talks about John von Neumann, a famous mathematician. Prasad says von Neumann's earlier lectures had nothing to do with aliens. Then suddenly, in 1948, a year after Roswell, the reported 1947 crash of a flying saucer in New Mexico, he started talking nonstop about machines that build copies of themselves, now called von Neumann machines. A guest on the same episode tells it the same way and adds 1949 as well. The suggestion is that, if true, his new ideas might have been inspired by something recovered from that crash.
